title: 桜の心
subtitle: Sakura no Kokoro
worriesTitle: What's on your mind right now?
worriesBody: Write one to five short words or phrases. They only exist during this game: nothing is saved or sent anywhere.
suggestions: A conversation I need to have
errBlank: Fill in or remove any empty fields.
errText: Use at least one letter or number.
loseTitle: The cherry tree has lost its petals
loseBody: That's all right. Breathing, letting go, and trying again are ways forward too. The tree will be here when you're ready.
instr: Protect the cherry tree for 120 seconds. Each ninja carries one of your worries.
If a ninja reaches the trunk, it steals a petal. If all petals are gone, you lose.
Each ninja you defeat restores a petal.
Keyboard: ←/→ or A/D move · ↑/W/Space jump · J/K slash · P or Esc pause.
Touch: use the left buttons to move and the right buttons to jump and slash.
A ninja hit briefly stuns you. Dodge when you see its yellow warning.
hint: Breathe. The cherry tree is waiting.
disclaimer: A quiet game to pass the time. It is not therapy or medical treatment.
tip: Tip: the game looks bigger in landscape.
